summary: GSK plc and GlaxoSmithKline Capital Inc. furnished a Form 6-K reporting second-quarter 2026 results previously announced on 28 July 2026. The filing covers sales of £8.4 billion (+5% AER, +5% CER), pipeline progress including FDA approval of Jideytro, and an agreement with the US Government for tariff relief and drug pricing. It is a routine earnings results announcement, not a special situation. No transactions, strategic reviews, or corporate events qualifying as special situations are described. The information is incorporated by reference into Form F-3 registration statements.
